policy: Every confirmed failure requires root cause, a code correction, executable regression test, recorded outcome and promotion evidence. A note without a fix keeps an issue open. Run every listed test in Docker and both offline local commands. Host READY is not a physical game, finance or public launch certificate.

incidents.rootCause: Build imported runtime secret-dependent config during Docker build instead of static config
Payment ledger test queried shortened, nonexistent transaction reference
Pointer test matched obsolete literal text instead of game touch behavior
Submission test expected mutable score rather than immutable finalScore snapshot
Journal overloaded source-only status with most recent failed build diagnostics
Source auditor constructed a library path for a slugless core game
Icon generator left stale aliases and favicon verifier refused a valid versioned URL

additionalRegressions.rootCause: Scanner treated a string literal example as an actual executable import and rejected a valid bundle
Existing game count hardcode meant new games would be rejected or silently untested
Mobile browser catalog smoke marked library games PASS on any canvas, without verifying signed game identity or actual playable state; narrow score route blocker risked unsafe API mutations
additionalRegressions.correction: Enforce signed run identity, Kit engine match, play/over state, remote QA run-start opt-in and deny-by-default API mutation routing
